categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Chicmax Cosmetic Co., Ltd. operates as a multi-brand cosmetics company focusing on research and development, manufacturing, and sales of skincare products, maternity and childcare products, washing and personal care products, and makeup products. The company manages several key brands including KANS (anti-aging skincare), One Leaf (natural skincare for younger users), Baby Elephant (maternity and childcare), and newpage (functional skincare for sensitive baby and children skin). It also plans to launch additional brands in various categories such as sensitive skincare, high-end anti-aging, maternity and childcare, washing and care, and makeup.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes independent R&D with dual research centers focusing on advanced fundamental research and product development. It invests in innovative ingredients such as 'CYCLOHEXAPEPTIDE-9' and 'X-peptide' for anti-aging effects. The company applies scientific research, process optimization, and clinical validation in product development, and integrates AI tools to enhance management and production efficiency. It also pursues intelligent production lines and automation upgrades to improve product quality and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are consumers in the cosmetics and personal care market, including segments for anti-aging skincare, maternity and childcare, and makeup. The company targets Asian women across various age groups, young consumers, mothers, and children. Its products are sold mainly through online direct sales, online retailers, and offline distributors and retailers, serving a broad consumer base in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in Mainland China, which accounts for the vast majority of its revenue and non-current assets. It also has operations and subsidiaries in Hong Kong and overseas, with some presence in Japan, Singapore, and Vietnam. The revenue from other countries and regions is minimal compared to Mainland China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Chicmax Cosmetic Co., Ltd. operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the cosmetics supply chain, focusing on product research and development, manufacturing, and sales. It manages production facilities, including a Fengxian plant undergoing capacity expansion and automation upgrades, and controls distribution through online and offline sales channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus includes maintaining R&D leadership with increased investment in fundamental research on core skincare ingredients like anti-aging and skin barrier repair technologies. It aims to innovate new raw materials, technologies, and formulas while enhancing consumer experience through pilot projects for new brands and products. The company also integrates AI-powered management tools to improve operational efficiency and pursues a multi-brand strategy with expansion into six major sectors including mass skincare, washing and personal care, maternity and baby products, skin medical beauty, makeup, and high-end skincare and instruments.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the manufacture and direct sales of cosmetic products across multiple brands. Sales channels include online direct sales, online retailers, online distributors, offline retailers, and offline distributors. The company also earns income from providing operational support, R&D, logistics, advertising, and other services to joint ventures and subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as one of the front runners in China’s cosmetics industry with a comprehensive multi-brand development and operational capability. Its KANS brand is a leading domestic scientific anti-aging skincare brand with strong online presence and rapid growth. The company competes with other domestic and international cosmetics brands in the skincare, maternity and childcare, and makeup segments, leveraging its multi-brand strategy and innovation to differentiate itself.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of RMB6,792.5 million, a 62.1% increase from RMB4,190.7 million in 2023. Gross profit rose by 69.2% to RMB5,109.4 million, and net profit increased to RMB803.3 million from RMB461.7 million. The company maintains a strong balance sheet with total assets of RMB3,596.6 million and net asset value of RMB2,234.7 million. It has a workforce of 2,086 employees and continues to invest significantly in R&D and capital expenditures to support growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Chicmax emphasizes scientific innovation and multi-brand strategy to meet diverse consumer needs, particularly focusing on anti-aging technology and safe, effective maternity and childcare products. Its proprietary ingredients like 'CYCLOHEXAPEPTIDE-9' and 'X-peptide' provide competitive differentiation. The company also integrates cultural elements and emotional marketing to enhance brand appeal, and balances online and offline channels to improve consumer experience and brand exposure.
